description: First micro-Shard: the Veil is demonstrably failing and resonance becomes observable to ordinary people
notes: Both drafts. Notion B1.A1.E1 lantern/Bywater flicker; export B1.A1 civic disturbance.

description: Filaments become a named presence: grassroots emotional care exists as an organised thing
notes: Notion B1.A1.E5 Filament Knot; export B1.A1 'Filament micro-introduction'.

description: Seraphine filters a Shard pulse instinctively; first prismatic signature appears
notes: Notion B1.A3.E12 'Seraphine's Emergence'. Foreshadows M33.

description: MT appears anonymously: an unattributed public voice begins reporting resonance
notes: Ruled 2026-09-19: MT visible ~B2, author unnamed until B4. Supersedes Notion B1.A2.E7.

description: Lucien breaks from the Dominion; the structural lineage loses its heir
notes: Notion B2.A2.E9 guilt / B3.A1.E2 refusal. Sets up M33 Silence succession.

description: The Ghostwave: mass involuntary emotional bleedthrough; the public can no longer be told nothing happened
notes: Notion B2.A2.E6. First public-scale resonance event.

description: Caro and Elisabet bond: the saga's steady emotional centre forms
notes: Notion B2.A1.E4 and B2.A2.E10. Ruled canon 2026-09-19. See milestone-gap note.

description: First Rupture, the Warehouse Incident: Rupture-level events are possible; NOLA carries a permanent resonance scar
notes: Notion B3.A3.E11. Scar recurs at M28 (B7.A3.E12).

description: The chronicler's VT slip: a mortal touches VT; Silence and Hope now know a human
notes: Recovered packet S1.T1.B3.A3.E14, anchored 'FIRST AND ONLY VT BRUSH IN VEIL TRILOGY'. Chronicler unnamed on page.

description: Baz dies
notes: Placement open: B3.A3 (Notion E13) or B3.EP. Ruled 2026-09-19 that the epilogue is a plausible home.

description: Tahl's exposure is revealed as the cause of the incident that killed Baz
notes: Ruled 2026-09-19. In neither draft; the saga's moral engine. Paid off at M12.

description: Tahl is named and revealed as MT's author; his remorse opens his protagonist arc
notes: Ruled 2026-09-19. Lands on Notion B4.A1.E1 'The Map No One Wants'. supplement_type CHAR is provisional.

description: Protocol 9 launched: resonance-active people become a monitored class
notes: Notion B4.A2.E7, Director Han Wei.

description: Saeko Morita's anti-resonance movement goes national
notes: Notion B4.A2.E6 'Emotion is entropy'.

description: Kade is seen: an accidental folk voice exists and Filament youth have a centre
notes: Notion B4.A2.E10. Sets up M23.

description: The Riot of Light: open civic violence over resonance
notes: Notion B4.A3.E15. Act named for it in the 27-Act Macro Structure.

description: First manufactured meta deployed publicly
notes: Notion B5.A2.E7 'Blinking Girl'. TECH supplement type provisional; left blank.

description: The Filaments fracture: 'Connection is survival' against 'Action is survival'
notes: Notion B4.A1.E5 first crack; B5.A2.E9 raid completes it.

description: The Colorstorm: emotional bleedthrough goes global; resonance becomes a weather system
notes: Notion B5.A3.E15. First global-scale event.

description: Tahl dies
notes: Notion B6.A3.E15, shielding a child on a collapsing transit platform.

description: Silence and Hope make their first choice: two constructs built without agency act
notes: Notion B6.A3.E13. Everything in Book 9 depends on this.

description: Tahl's Echo is caught in VT: death is not the end of him
notes: Notion B6.A3.E15. Enables M27, M33, M36.

description: MT passes to Kade; the channel's voice changes permanently
notes: Notion B6 aftermath unit E20, 'I'm here. I won't hide.'

description: Global infrastructure collapse: governments admit there is no containment pathway
notes: Notion B7.A1.E5 'SYSTEMIC INFRASTRUCTURE FAILURE'.

description: The diaspora begins: millions move and the world's population map is rewritten
notes: Notion B7.A2.E6. Filament diaspora activates.

description: MT becomes the last intact channel
notes: Notion B7.A1.E3 and B5.A3.E11 foreshadow. Post-Mending bible 5.4 confirms MT as backbone.

description: Tahl's Echo shows Intent: he is an agent again, not a residue
notes: Notion B7.A3.E14, 'Go where it began.'

description: Exodus from New Orleans toward the swamp
notes: Notion B7.A3.E15. Warehouse scar destabilises; the city cannot hold them.

description: First Echo Node discovered and stabilised: the Breathable Veil has a working blueprint
notes: Notion B8.A3.E11, Elisabet discovers it and Seraphine stabilises it.

description: Technarc collapses; its metas fail
notes: Notion B8.A3.E13 and end state. Leaves Dominion alone for Book 9.

description: The swamp convergence: the finale's conditions exist
notes: Notion B8.A3.E15, cataclysmic fade-to-white.

description: Silence and Hope arrive and confess: 'I was afraid.' 'I was alone.'
notes: Notion B9.A3.E12. Their agency becomes speech.

description: The Mending: the hard-cap Veil ends, the Breathable Veil forms, Silence and Hope dissolve into Lucien and Caro
notes: Notion B9.A3.E14, 'the cosmological core of the saga'. Era boundary begins here.

description: The Lightfall: resonance storms stop worldwide
notes: Notion B9.A3.E15. Post-Mending envelope applies from here.

description: MT is renamed LT; Kade's stewardship completes
notes: Notion B9 E20 and Post-Mending bible 7.3. A rename, not a channel conversion.

description: Tahl's Echo dissolves: 'Be kind for me.'
notes: Notion B9 E21. Releases the saga's moral foundation.
